snippet.title: Mystic Fog Maze | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Get Mystic Fog Maze: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5349900

Mystic Fog Maze is a casual puzzle game where the player navigates through endless mazes surrounded by a mysterious fog.

Music by @OvaniSound
